game.name: Race for the Galaxy
game.sourceNotes: Mechanical values transcribed from the open-source RFTG AI card database (bnordli/rftg, src/cards.txt), expansion level 0, promos excluded. Structural totals cross-checked against the official 2nd edition rulebook. No card text or artwork reproduced.

knownGaps: This file contains the 5 basic start worlds only. The 2nd edition rulebook lists 11 start worlds in the box (5 basic + 6 optional for experienced players); the source database assigns the additional start worlds to expansion levels, so their base-set membership could not be confirmed and they are deliberately excluded rather than guessed. Consequently this file holds 95 definitions / 114 physical cards rather than 101 / 120.

With the 5 basic start worlds only, the payment-world cost distribution is [2,6,11,10,5,5,2,0] against a rulebook expectation of [2,6,17,9,4,5,2,0] for the full 120-card box. The military distribution differs only by the 2 missing military start worlds. The residual +1 at cost 3 and +1 at cost 4 is unexplained and needs a human check.
Cards are described by structured powers only. Printed card text is not reproduced.
